sections.whatsHappening: More than 20 days have passed since you served the claim, and the defendant has not filed a defence. You can now ask the court to note the defendant in default.
sections.whatToDoNext: File a Request to Clerk (Form 9B) to note the defendant in default. You must also provide proof that the claim was served within the court's territorial division.
sections.whatHappensAfter: Once the defendant is noted in default, the clerk may sign a default judgment (Form 11B) against the defendant for the claim or part of the claim that is for a debt or liquidated demand in money.
